plan.summary:
Links now store their folder in a new `folder_id` column, so the folder view needs no join.

- A new migration adds the nullable `folder_id` column and an index on it.
- `move_link` writes `folder_id` together with `dirty`.
- The `Link` proto message gets a `folder_id` field. An empty value means the root.
- A comment in the older links migration is reworded.
plan.riskRationale: This change adds a schema column and a write path. Existing rows get a NULL `folder_id`, and the proto uses an empty string for root. Nothing shown backfills old rows or maps NULL to empty.
plan.storyArc: The column is added first. Then the write path fills it. Last, the proto exposes it to clients.

noise.reason: Comment-only edit in an older migration. No schema change.

topics.title: Add folder_id column and index to links
topics.narrativeBrief: What schema change lets links store their folder? Verify the column is nullable, has no default, and that existing rows are not backfilled.

topics.title: Write folder_id when a link moves
dependsOn: Add folder_id column and index to links
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `move_link` now keep the cached folder correct? It sets `folder_id` and `dirty` in one UPDATE. Check that other write paths, such as link creation, are not shown here.

topics.title: Expose folder_id in the Link proto
dependsOn: Write folder_id when a link moves
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the API contract gain? A `folder_id` field 3 is added, and empty means root. Verify that the NULL column value maps to an empty string wherever the message is built.
